map.求 a 除以 b 的余数。: Find the remainder of a divided by b.
map.a mod b = a − b × ⌊a ÷ b⌋，即 a 除以 b 的余数，结: a mod b = a − b × ⌊a ÷ b⌋, the remainder of a divided by b, with the sign following the dividend a; e.g. 17 mod 5 = 2; commonly used for periodic modulo, circular indices, and hash bucket selection (the congruence a ≡ a mod b is congruent modulo b).
